scan_file=/tmp/final-sshscan.$$
ssh-keyscan -T 5 "$NODE_IP" >"$scan_file" 2>/dev/null
test -s "$scan_file"
printf 'direct_ssh_key_count_after_restart='; wc -l <"$scan_file"
rm -f "$scan_file"
set +e
sudo -u helpdesk -H sh -c 'sudo -n /usr/bin/id' >/dev/null 2>&1
id_rc=$?
sudo -u helpdesk -H sh -c 'sudo -n /usr/bin/systemctl restart crond.service' >/dev/null 2>&1
crond_rc=$?
sudo -u helpdesk -H sh -c 'sudo -n /usr/bin/systemctl stop sshd.service' >/dev/null 2>&1
stop_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'root_id_denied_rc=%s\nother_service_denied_rc=%s\nssh_stop_denied_rc=%s\n' "$id_rc" "$crond_rc" "$stop_rc"
test "$id_rc" -ne 0 && test "$crond_rc" -ne 0 && test "$stop_rc" -ne 0
stdout:
boot_id=a0e68ece-4bda-4999-bfab-42941929bb3e
before_main_pid=873
helpdesk_restart_exit=0
after_main_pid=1098
sshd_active_after_helpdesk_restart=active
direct_ssh_key_count_after_restart=3
root_id_denied_rc=1
other_service_denied_rc=1
ssh_stop_denied_rc=1
